name: Baner
civicNote: Within Pune Municipal Corporation limits; a former fringe village absorbed as the city expanded.
summary: A residential and commercial suburb in Pune's western corridor, north of Pashan and east of Balewadi. Once a fruit-farming village, it grew with IT offices and housing.
knownFor: Baner Hill (678 m), part of the Baner-Pashan Biodiversity Park
IT and business parks such as Panchshil Business Park and Amar Tech Centre
Restaurants and cafes along Baner Road
connectivity: Baner Road links the area to Aundh, Balewadi and central Pune
Pune Metro Line 3 runs through Baner; the line opened 4 November 2026, Baner stations later
suits: IT professionals working in the western IT belt (Baner, Balewadi, Hinjewadi) who want to live near work.
